positions.title: Sr. Technical Product Manager
positions.description: Responsible for eContracting - a SAAS product that enables auto dealers to procure loans for customers via the web. The loan documentation, electronic signatures and delivery of the documents to the bank are handled via the service.  Implemented retail LAW contract in 20 states (30 had been completed) and Lease in all states with a dozen different finance sources from Chase Bank to the Nissan captive NMAC, BOA, Fifth Third, etc. Increased total $s contracted at new Car dealerships from approx. $100M to $1.2B

positions.title: eCommerce Technology Manager
positions.description: Deployed enterprise inventory, order-management and online store for a variety of departments. Managed a large multi-function team in a matrix style. Continued to solve some technology challenges via hands-on coding when necessary
